scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:deploy: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-ai run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.ci:typecheck: tsc --build lib/db/tsconfig.json lib/api-zod/tsconfig.json lib/api-client-react/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run typecheck
scripts.ci:build: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-ai run build
scripts.ci: pnpm run ci:typecheck && pnpm run ci:test && pnpm run ci:build
